sources.title: The Licensing of Houses in Multiple Occupation (Mandatory Conditions of Licences) (England) Regulations 2018
sources.note: Sets national mandatory minimum sleeping-room sizes for licensed HMOs in England.

england_national_2018.title: England national mandatory HMO sleeping-room minimums
notes: Rooms smaller than 4.64 square metres must not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Local licensing conditions can be stricter; verify the relevant council licence conditions before giving compliance advice.
Indexed by postcode area only. A full postcode may cross council boundaries, so use this as a national statutory baseline and confirm local licence conditions.
